item.name: Show the SBOM of the release.

request.name: Show the SBOM of the release.

description.content:
Show the SBOM of an upstream release in a given format
  * [SPDX spec](https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v2.2.2/document-creation-information/)
  * [CycloneDX spec](https://cyclonedx.org/specification/overview/)

To request an SBOM, both a file format and SBOM type must be specified.

The file format can be specified in several ways:
  * using the `format` query parameter
  * using the `Accept` header
  * using a file extension on the route (e.g. sbom.json to request the JSON file format).

The SBOM type can be specified using the `sbom_type` query parameter.

Supported combinations:
  * `sbom_type=cyclonedx`, `format=xml`
  * `sbom_type=cyclonedx`, `format=json`
  * `sbom_type=spdx`, `format=spdx`
    * for SPDX, only specifying `format` is necessary, `sbom_type` can be inferred

Older versions of the API supported an `sbom_format` query parameter (without specifying both `sbom_type` and
format). The following mappings are provided to maintain backwards compatibility.
  * `sbom_format=cyclonedx` implies `sbom_type=cyclonedx` and `format=xml`
  * `sbom_format=spdx` implies `sbom_type=spdx` and `format=spdx`

query.description: The type the SBOM to generate. Required, unless older sbom_format parameter is passed.

(Required) The name of the package to look up.
(Required) The version of the package to look up.
